Metadata.title: Lucas Portela
Metadata.description: Lucas Portela studies Computer Science in Maceió, Brazil, is looking for a development internship, and builds websites for people who need one.

Home.name: portelav
Home.headline: I'm Lucas Portela, and I've built a few <accent>websites that are live</accent>.
Home.lead: I study Computer Science in Maceió, Brazil. I'm looking for a development internship, and I build websites for people who need one.

landing.alt: First screen of Dr. Thaiane Lessa's website: the headline “sorrir é sempre uma boa ideia”.
landing.codeLabel: See the code for Dr. Thaiane Lessa's website
landing.name: Dr. Thaiane Lessa
landing.what: A page for a dental surgeon in Maceió that introduces her and takes visitors to WhatsApp.
landing.part: All of it, from design to code, made for phones first.
landing.decision: No patients, no before-and-after photos and no promised results, because of the Brazilian dental council's advertising rules.

draftcs.alt: First screen of DraftCS: the call “Monte o time invencível”.
draftcs.name: DraftCS
draftcs.what: You draw a real Counter-Strike Major roster, pick five players and simulate the run for the title.
draftcs.part: Curating player, roster and country data, the simulator's scrolling on phones, and the area for sharing results.

crewz.alt: First screen of Crewz: the line “Encontre quem quer fazer o que você quer fazer”.
crewz.name: Crewz
crewz.what: You find groups, events and people by activity, like cycling, running or book clubs.
crewz.part: Design system, visual redesign, onboarding, profile, direct messages and search.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.lead: If you want to talk about an internship or a website, reach me here.

About.title: About
About.text: I study Computer Science and I care about the small details: how a website feels on a phone, the timing of each animation, the words on each button.
About.repo: This website's code is public, with its decisions on record in the <link>repository</link>.
About.photoAlt: Illustration of Lucas Portela, smiling, with a beard and a black T-shirt.

Hire.title: Need a website?
Hire.lead: I build the page for your business from design to code, made for phones first, with a direct path to your WhatsApp.
Hire.step1: You tell me what you need.
Hire.step2: We agree on scope and deadline in writing.
Hire.step3: You follow along through a preview link.
Hire.whatsappMessage: Hi Lucas, I need a website.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.text: This website counts visits and where they come from, so I know whether it's being seen. Vercel does the counting, through Web Analytics, without cookies. Your theme choice stays in your browser.
